scripts.dev: bun server/scripts/ensure-dev-vars.ts && bun run db:migrate:local && bun run --cwd web-vue dev
scripts.start: bun server/scripts/ensure-dev-vars.ts && bun run build:web && bun --env-file=.dev.vars server/src/bun.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server && bun run worker:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd web-vue typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd server-shared/contracts typecheck
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.db:migrate:local: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply hvbc --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply hvbc --remote
scripts.deploy: bun run build:web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler-config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy
scripts.verify: bun run types && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:all && bun run build && bun run test:boot && bun run db:migrate:local
